comparison_order_design: one seeded randomized complete block per repeat and graph size; each block contains both candidate arms on process-CoW, serialization, and native-full-copy backends

protocol.fork_eligibility: Linux only; one process thread; no Python hooks, agent thread, initialized memory faculty, pending graph effects/attribute-write observations, framebuffer handles, or native reads_external rules
limits: no external OS sandbox; eligibility is a source/runtime effect guard, not security isolation
protocol.parent_invariant: exact canonical graph and native rewrite-rule digests before fork equal digests after child exit and before receipt persistence
protocol.residual_return: child sends full graph-diff conclusions and derived-only residual over a pipe; parent stores JSON and digest in ThoughtexperimentReceipt without merging branch state

timing_components.copy_control_median_ms: full model-before plus branch rehearsal/readout; fixture construction excluded
timing_components.process_cow_child_wall_ms: child candidate rehearsal through residual assembly, excludes pipe transfer
timing_components.process_cow_fork_child_pipe_ms: fork through child completion and residual transfer; includes branch execution/readout
timing_components.process_cow_model_before_ms: separately reported native full-copy baseline prediction cost
timing_components.process_cow_total_wall_ms: sum of model-before, fork-child-pipe, and receipt persistence; fixture construction excluded
